verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents its own bulk capabilities in detail. The asynchronous Bulk Write API inserts, updates, or upserts up to 25,000 records per call and reports job completion via a callback URL or status polling. An asynchronous bulk API also pushes or retrieves large data volumes, standard insert takes up to 100 records per call, and a composite API combines up to five calls. For AI-native use, the official MCP server explicitly offers bulk operations on multiple records. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk jobs at scale, and detail on which bulk operations the MCP server exposes and their limits.
